fullPassage: It was thought at first that AI would end discrimination and bias, by taking human bigotry out of the loop. Unfortunately, some famous studies have indicated that bias can still occur. For example, AI was shown to do a better job of recognizing white people, as compared to dark-skinned people. The bad performance was blamed on biased training data for the machine learning algorithm. Today, the conventional wisdom holds that biased training data are what cause AI bias, implying that unbiased training data will solve the problem. This is false. Although biased training data can, in fact, be a source of algorithmic bias, such bias can emerge even from unbiased data. For example, Lambrecht and Tucker showed that a gender-neutral ad could nevertheless discriminate against women, for the ironic reason that targeting women is sometimes more expensive, leading to fewer ads that target women.

det.tip: second-highest(두 번째로 높은). percentage point(퍼센트포인트) = 절대 차이 단위.

questions.stem: 밑줄 친 <u>similar</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ disparate: '전혀 다른, 이질적인'은 similar의 반의어.
❌ ① comparable: '비교할 만한'은 similar의 동의어.
❌ ② alike: '비슷한'은 similar의 동의어.
❌ ④ equivalent: '동등한'은 similar의 동의어.
det.tip: similar(비슷한) = comparable, alike ↔ disparate(전혀 다른), dissimilar(다른).

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장에서  share의 의미로 가장 적절한 것을 짝지은 것은?

(A) The graph shows the <u>shares</u> of renewable electricity generation by region.
(B) Please <u>share</u> this information with your team.

det.analysis:
✅ ② (A) 점유율 — (B) 공유하다: (A)에서 share는 명사로 '점유율, 비율', (B)에서 share는 동사로 '공유하다, 나누다'.
❌ ① (A) 주식 — (B) 분배하다: (A)는 통계 맥락이므로 '주식'이 아닌 '점유율'.
❌ ③ (A) 공유 — (B) 점유하다: (A)의 명사 의미가 반대.
❌ ④ (A) 몫 — (B) 투자하다: (B)는 '투자하다'가 아닌 '공유하다'.
det.tip: share — 명사: 점유율, 비율, 주식, 몫 / 동사: 공유하다, 나누다.

"the process of producing electricity or other forms of energy"

det.analysis:
✅ ③ generation: '전기나 에너지를 생산하는 과정'으로 영영풀이와 정확히 일치.
❌ ① distribution: '배전, 유통'은 생산이 아닌 전달 과정.
❌ ② consumption: '소비'는 생산의 반대.
❌ ④ transmission: '송전'은 에너지 전달.
det.tip: generation(발전, 생성) — electricity generation = 전력 생산. generate(동사: 생성하다).
